name: Cloudflare

field_reviews.reason: Official Fundamentals docs (fetched live via search index): 'Cloudflare uses the RFC standard Authorization: Bearer <token> interface' for API tokens, created self-serve under My Profile > API Tokens or Manage Account > API Tokens.

All three confirmed: scoped API tokens as Bearer (recommended), legacy Global API Key via X-Auth-Key/X-Auth-Email ('less secure than API tokens', per the draft's exact evidence page developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/), and OAuth for the managed MCP servers (cloudflare/mcp repo: OAuth recommended, API token bearer for CI/CD).

Free self-serve accounts; user and account-owned API tokens are created instantly in the dashboard or via the token-creation API — confirmed on the live Create API token and Account API tokens docs pages.

The v4 REST API (api.cloudflare.com/client/v4) spans the whole platform; Cloudflare's own MCP repo describes covering 'over 2,500 endpoints' of the Cloudflare API, plus the separate GraphQL Analytics API.

REST v4 confirmed live; GraphQL Analytics API documented (API-token Bearer auth per the docs source the draft cited); managed MCP servers at mcp.cloudflare.com confirmed via the official cloudflare/mcp repo.

Repo ownership verified: github.com/cloudflare/mcp exists under the cloudflare org ('MCP server for the Cloudflare API', ~737 stars), backing the managed server at mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp. Composio catalog listing of Cloudflare toolkits matches the draft's citation.
Free account + instant scoped tokens + broad documented API; nothing gates building today.
No blocker; API access is fully self-serve on the free tier.

notes: The draft noted developers.cloudflare.com fetches timed out during first-pass research; this pass reached the live Fundamentals pages (get-started, create-token, account-owned-tokens, make-api-calls, dated Apr 2026) through search and they say exactly what the draft claimed: Bearer API tokens recommended, legacy Global API Key discouraged, self-serve creation. Also opened the draft's cloudflare/mcp evidence repo directly to verify vendor ownership. All eight fields stand as drafted.
